Cup of the Doge

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Cup_of_the_Doge

The Doge of the City of the Shuttered Windows drinks his bloodied wine chilled from a cup fashioned from the scale of a gold dragon. These scales draw in heat.

Many in the City seek to ape the Doge’s fashion and secure gold dragon scales of their own or better yet the breath of a silver dragon that is said to be able to dissolve curses and banish sorceries.
